card.name: Lerato
card.situation: Operations coordinator at a logistics company in Pretoria. Has been there five years.
card.day_to_day: Schedules deliveries, sorts out problems with drivers and warehouses, and keeps the weekly delivery reports up to date in spreadsheets.
card.strongest_skill: Organising operations and solving problems under pressure.
card.skill_example: During a fuel strike, re-planned a week of deliveries so that every hospital client still got their stock on time.
card.wants_next: To move into tech. Has no coding experience, but is curious about tech companies.
card.work_arrangement: Prefers hybrid but is open to the office.
card.notice_period: First says one month. Later in the call, corrects it: it is actually two months.
card.salary_stance: Happy to share: about R32,000 a month.
card.behaviour: Changes her answer on notice period mid-call: says one month, then later says she checked and it is two months.
